integrity: The cycle-boundary projective map is reconstructed directly from the exact steepest-descent step and differentiated symbolically. The source full text was inspected at its exact two- and three-mode counterexamples and surrounding discussion. Exact symbolic replay verifies both return-map Jacobians and their product.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a local projective-stability result for the full-support three-mode arithmetic-spectrum CSD orbit with cycle length two. It does not classify global basins, other exceptional cycles, larger active spectra, or nonquadratic objectives.
title: Universal multiplier-three repulsion of the three-mode CSD exceptional orbit
